highlights: Presentation of valid ID required before entering premises
Passcode locks on interior doors and outside gates bolted at all times
Continuous CCTV coverage and all staff police checked
Daily PM 2.5 real-time monitoring and Air Purifiers in all rooms
Morning temperature checks and strict allergen control
safety.policy_summary: Lovell International School maintains rigorous health, safety, and hygiene protocols, including mandatory visitor identification, passcode-secured interior doors, continuous CCTV coverage, and police background checks for all staff. The school actively monitors daily PM 2.5 air quality indices and heat indexes to adjust outdoor activities, alongside comprehensive accident recording, sickness isolation procedures, and strict food allergen controls.
